results.sql: CREATE TABLE post_stakes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, post_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, amount_usd REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'locked', appeal_deadline TEXT, appeal_reason TEXT, appeal_status TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES posts(id), FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id))
